title: Stop telling people you used AI for your games
author: butwhataboutmen42
selftext:
Just use it and don’t tell anyone. There’s no way to tell adequately made games used AI without deep investigation and if they do that, we start investigating AAA code. 

Almost all the people who would hate on your game will not be able to tell, especially if you add pro-LGBT or any woke messaging, it’ll make them look bad for singling you out.

comments.author: BandicootWide8250
comments.body:
I disagree, but I'm not doing this to make a ton of money. I just want people to have fun and get engaged with making their own games.

Eventually great AI games are going to start getting people's attention and then all of those people will be irrelevant. That only happens though if developers proudly state their game has AI and don't try and hide it

replies.author: Chordant
replies.body:
Well Steam is at least one platform where disclosure of at least some categories of AI use is mandatory. You might be able to get away with not disclosing, but if you're caught you can expect to at least be delisted, and the penalties only get worse from there.

If you don't wanna disclose and don't want to get in trouble for not disclosing, then choose a platform that doesn't require it.

Yes I know. That's why I said:
> Well Steam is at least one platform where **disclosure of at least some categories of AI use is mandatory.**

replies.author: Chordant
replies.body: It depends on where you're distributing your game from, and what specifically you used AI for. If you used it for player-facing content (art, music, etc.) then on Steam consumers do have the right to know about it.

comments.author: Ok-File-2759
comments.body: Not sure why so many people are disagreeing with you about simply not disclosing the use of AI. It’s a tool. If you’re disclosing every other tool you used to make the game, then sure, I understand disclosing AI. But why are we expected to disclose the use of only one specific type of tool used to make the game? To make the people who have been propagandized into believing any AI use is bad happy? If something is slop, it’s slop, simply using AI doesn’t make it slop

replies.author: Ok-File-2759
replies.body: Child labor, allergies, and other immoral or dangerous things are completely different from using a tool. I’m not going to disclose using VS Code as my IDE, why should I disclose using AI to write my scripts? If someone “calls out” VS Code use in my game, I will say yes, then continue looking for more ways to use it to help build out my ideas, same exact response with AI use

comments.author: Kindly-Sail6260
comments.body:
Yea this a not a good take. I know you want people to avoid scrutiny or being downvoted to oblivion because of AI but this is a minority of people yelling the loudest at the moment. This happened with far left and right wing people who we all ignore at this point because they’re just fringe groups. The same will have for the Anit and pro AI people. Most of us will be in the middle and we’ll ignore everyone else. 

I know that House House got their reviews cooked but if you look at the graph, there was an influx of support as well so nothing has really changed and probably brought more attention and sales to the game. Their apology letter didn’t even satisfy the Antis. All to say, being dishonest for anything has never helped anyone long term. Pushing for honesty in this space will be better for everyone overall
